# Test fixtures

Real responses recorded on 18 November 2026, used so the parsers are tested against what the
services actually return:

| File | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open-meteo-forecast.json` | Open-Meteo forecast for Komenda, Slovenia, six models | CC BY 4.0, Open-Meteo.com |
| `open-meteo-geocoding.json` | Open-Meteo geocoding search for "Komenda" | CC BY 4.0, Open-Meteo.com / GeoNames |
| `open-meteo-flood.json` | Open-Meteo Flood API for the Pšata river | contains modified Copernicus EMS information |
| `arso-gauges.xml` | ARSO river gauges, four stations kept | ARSO, Slovenian Environment Agency |
| `arso-text.xml` | ARSO text forecast for Slovenia | ARSO, Slovenian Environment Agency |
